messages.content: A farmer has 17 sheep. All but 9 run away. How many are left? Explain briefly.

message.content:
**9 are left.**

"All but 9 ran away" means *everyone except 9* ran away. So 9 remain.
message.reasoning_content: This is a classic trick question. The phrasing "all but 9 run away" means that all the sheep ran away EXCEPT 9. So 9 sheep are left. People often misread this as "all 17 minus 9 ran away" (which would give 8), but "all but 9" means "everyone except 9."
